title: Drifter Bar Salts Grape 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Drifter Bar Salts Grape is a lush and vibrant fruit e-liquid, delivering the classic and universally loved taste of grapes. It's a blend that combines the sweetness and tanginess of ripe grapes, offering a flavour profile that is both juicy and indulgent. Each puff immerses you in the taste of freshly picked grapes, but with a little fruit candy sugariness thrown in for good measure. Upon inhaling, you’ll experience the juicy and rich burst of grape, bringing to mind the pleasure of biting into a ripe, succulent grape. This is complemented by a subtle, sugary candy notes, which adds depth and character to the vape. The grape flavour is expertly crafted to be as authentic as it is enjoyable, ensuring a perfect choice for those who love a fruity and straightforward vaping experience. Drifter's Bar Salts e-liquids are the perfect choice for starter vape kits and low-powered pod devices. Unlike regular freebase e-liquids, nicotine salts feature an alkaline formulation that allows for a higher concentration of nicotine while delivering a smoother throat hit than high-strength freebase liquids. Nicotine salt e-liquids provide near-instant relief from nicotine cravings because the nicotine is absorbed into the bloodstream faster. This makes them an ideal choice for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking immediate, satisfying nicotine relief. Drifter's Bar Salts and Bar Juice collections offer mouth-watering e-liquids inspired by the most popular flavours found in disposable vapes. They're just as intensely delicious and satisfying as disposable vape flavours, but with the added benefit of being compatible with your own reusable vape device. This saves you money and reduces waste in the process. Why not try other incredible flavours from Drifter's Bar Salts and Bar Juice collections? From sweet and refreshing Cotton Candy Ice to classics like Cherry and Blue Razz Lemonade, whatever your taste in e-liquid, Drifter E-liquid has an incredible flavour waiting to light up your tastebuds.
